brief.prompt: Hello, dear. It’s Nell. I have mended this chapter’s pages more than once, and I still hold my breath at the sixteenth step. The children find a well, a golden chess knight, and a door under the ivy. Build what Edmund’s torch finds at the bottom: a path up the middle, chests and treasures along both sides, and the gifts hanging at the far wall. Then tell me what one of them brought back.
